text:
Subject: drilling fluid release near Hope BC
Hey compliance,
Patrol flight spotted drilling rig just east of Hope at 13:51 on Sept 3. Rig pad right beside
Prairie Midstream ROW. Meter showed 2.0 m³ drilling mud escaped. Mud ran down slope,
crossed the ROW, and pooled at wetland/creek edge. Ground crew threw up silt fence before
I left, but nobody's checked if any made it into the water yet.
Looks like contractor didn't adjust for the heat-ground's dry and cracking. No signs they
called it in themselves.
Let me know if you need photos or follow-up.
Jake
Pipeline Patrol Contractor
